scope: Read-only source and saved capture audit; no source, tool, firmware, COM, JTAG, PnP, process, or hardware state modified

confirmed_contract_mismatch.runner: Ground uses the selected ExplicitHostArm workflow; every non-Ground role is assigned SyncOnly and sent a 28-byte ClockRequest
confirmed_contract_mismatch.candidate_compile_mode: VC_LORA_R19_USB_READINESS_MODE=2 is the sealed candidate build flag, not a declaration that Vehicle implements a separate SyncOnly endpoint
confirmed_contract_mismatch.firmware: Private clock request parser, response state, response writer, and USB collection path are compiled under VC_LORA_PHASE6_GROUND
confirmed_contract_mismatch.vehicle_normal_ingress: Reads pixhawk_serial, not the USB Serial clock request stream
confirmed_contract_mismatch.consequence: The PC Vehicle SyncOnly workflow cannot obtain its required ClockReply from this firmware. The observed 5-second acquisition rejection is therefore an unsupported diagnostic expectation, not proof of a byte reader or RF failure.
confirmed_contract_mismatch.not_proven_by_pc_write: SerialPort.Write returning without exception proves PC-local acceptance only; it does not prove MCU command parsing or response support.

vehicle.all_frames: 63-byte MAVLink2 STATUSTEXT from system 254/component 190; R19A:V:L diagnostic ALIVE only
vehicle.raw_handshake_replay: NOT_ESTABLISHED: Saved native raw must contain one exact matching CRC-valid clock reply

ground.subsequent_mcu_record_binding: Normalizer additionally requires same nonce, stable epoch, reader_session, clock-request MCU timestamp, and boot tuple from the acquired MCU record

timeout_and_reader_interpretation: The 5-second timeout originates at PC workflow construction, not MCU setup and not COM Open.
It is separate from the product 106-ms USB completion budget and the private reply 500-ms transaction budget.
Vehicle does not require READY or ARM in its PC SyncOnly workflow; its rejection is solely due to no matching ClockReply.
Both native read owners start before the corresponding ClockRequest write; this run is not explained by the PC beginning Read after sending the request.
Native read TimeoutException increments a timeout counter and continues; zero read errors and complete CRC-valid raw frames show no parser truncation in these saved streams.
Reader FirstReadBeginTicks is an application call-entry timestamp, not independent proof of a kernel-pending read or physical USB IN poll.
Both workflow loops continue raw acquisition after a private handshake rejection; the 40-second capture is not automatically invalidated by Vehicle's unsupported SyncOnly response expectation.
corrections_to_possible_prior_interpreta: Vehicle ClockReply absence is not sufficient to label this run a CDC hardware or byte-reader failure because the queried Vehicle service is not implemented.
The first captured diagnostic frame is ALIVE, not ARMED, on both roles. Earlier pre-capture ARMED transmission cannot be inferred from these first raw frames.
No malformed or partial 28-byte ClockReply is present in Vehicle raw: it consists exclusively of 42 complete CRC-valid 63-byte ALIVE frames.
Ground's READY and diagnostic ARM are valid and bound to the observed reply; the remaining Vehicle PC-workflow rejection does not negate that Ground result.
R19 diagnostic ARM is private USB admission and must not be confused with Pixhawk flight arming.

source_evidence.claim: Separate serial roles, 20-ms read/write timeouts, early reader arming, Vehicle SyncOnly assignment, 5-second workflow, continued capture, stop and close
Ground-only ExplicitHostArm, PC-started acquisition timer, SyncOnly reply completion, READY nonce/time/binding checks, ARM restrictions
Write acceptance is local, strict private parser, saved raw handshake replay, Ground MCU session/nonce/epoch/boot binding
ARM echoes READY tuple and requires proof flags exactly 3
Clock/READY service is Ground-only; Vehicle ingress reads pixhawk_serial instead of USB Serial
Independent raw CRC scan used this repository's message-ID CRC-extra table

limitations: This audit does not independently prove actual USB OUT delivery or physical FIFO state; PC acceptance, raw bytes, firmware support, and MCU records are separate evidence boundaries.
Raw CRC validation covers unsigned MAVLink2 frames in these two saved streams, not cryptographic authentication or RF integrity beyond the captured data.
No fresh trial, firmware upload, source modification, host timeout relaxation, or additional device query was performed.
No product acceptance, deployment authorization, full 932-parameter acquisition, or 30-second-throughput result is implied.
